name: עֲמָלֵקִי
summary: The Amalekites, the people of Amalek, whose territory the kings struck in Genesis 14:7; one man says “I am an Amalekite”. The gentilic is formed from the name עֲמָלֵק, whose derivation is not given.

evidence.note: The singular gentilic in שְׂדֵה הָעֲמָלֵקִי identifies the Amalekites as the people whose territory the kings struck.
Asked who he is, the speaker answers עֲמָלֵקִי אָנֹכִי, “I am an Amalekite.”

note: Moved from the former word entry `3eamaaleeqiy`. Its old root key עמלק followed the consonants of עֲמָלֵק, the name given in Genesis 36:12. TIPNR has no group record for the Amalekites: it files the gentilic under the land, Amalek@Gen.14.7, which is named here.
